# lock

Distributed locks (in memory only in local/test; shared environments need lock-redis or lock-dynamodb)

```bash
axiz add lock
```

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Starter | `pe.axiz:axiz-lock-spring-boot-starter` |
| Stacks del catálogo | servlet, reactive |
| Incluida por defecto en | ningún arquetipo |

## Uso

```java
// the lease is checked right before the effect; the debit itself is idempotent (key) in the core
lockTemplate.withLock("account:" + id, Duration.ofSeconds(10), Duration.ofSeconds(2), lease -> {
  lease.ensureHeld();
  return core.debit(id, amount, idempotencyKey);
});
```
